    • calcWaxFormerFraction

      public double calcWaxFormerFraction(int componentNumber)
      Pedersen wax-forming mole fraction of a TBP or plus fraction.

      z_wax / z_total = 1 - (A + B M)((rho - rhoP) / rhoP)^C, with M in g/mol, rho the normal liquid density in g/cm3 and rhoP the n-paraffin density 0.3915 + 0.0675 ln M. A fraction that is not denser than the n-paraffin of the same molar mass is treated as entirely wax forming (the base of the power would otherwise be negative and the result NaN). The result is bounded to [0, 1] so that no split creates negative moles.

      Parameters:
      componentNumber - index of the TBP, plus or wax pseudo component in phase 0
      Returns:
      wax-forming fraction of the total moles of that fraction, in [0, 1]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if molar mass, density or model parameters are not finite and positive

    • addTBPWax

      public void addTBPWax()
      addTBPWax.

      TBP and plus fractions are split into a non-wax part and a wax-forming wax-prefixed pseudo component using calcWaxFormerFraction(int). The split is idempotent: when a wax pseudo component already exists, the total moles of the pair are re-split with the current parameters, so repeated calls (for example during parameter tuning) do not move more and more of the fraction into wax. A TBP fraction added after an earlier split is split on the next call. Named components flagged as wax formers in the component database (the n-paraffins) are wax formers as a whole and are not split. They keep their database melting temperature and heat of fusion; where the database holds only its placeholder default (273.0 K and 6000 J/mol, currently nC15 and nC17 to nC24) they receive the Pedersen correlations of this model instead (#5210).

      Specified by:
      addTBPWax in interface WaxModelInterface
      Overrides:

    • addNamedWaxFormerProperties

      private void addNamedWaxFormerProperties()
      Assigns the Pedersen melting (triple-point) temperature and heat of fusion to named wax formers that have no fusion data in the component database.

      A named wax former is a database component with the wax-former flag set that is neither a TBP nor a plus fraction and is not a wax-prefixed pseudo component created by this model. Database fusion data are kept where they exist. A component whose database values are the placeholder default (273.0 K and 6000.0 J/mol) gets the correlated values, and keeps getting them on later calls so that the tuning multipliers parameterWaxTriplePointTemperature and parameterWaxHeatOfFusion apply to it. The values are written to the component in every allocated phase, including an already created wax phase, so the result does not depend on whether addSolidComplexPhase("wax") was called before or after addTBPWax().
